text:
zoe: FYI PolarVector invoice INV-0426-331 arrived but is on hold. Looks like PO mismatch + bank change in same submission. :(

matt: Can you paste the PO printed on the invoice PDF? Ill try an auto-match.

zoe: Invoice PO = PV-4100-LEG. Our active PO for them is PV-2026-420 (post consolidation).

harper: Quick context  PolarVector merged payment entities last week. AP accidentally used a legacy PO when reissuing. Correct PO should be PV-2026-420. They also updated receiving bank to a new payments entity.

```
legacy_account: PV-LEG-55
new_account: PV-PAY-990 (effective 2026-04-10)
```

kai: Any bank change triggers KBA and procurement confirmation for supplier legal entity changes. Im out till EOD but will pick up ticket tomorrow.

approvals-bot: Hold applied: reasons=[PO_MISMATCH,BANK_CHANGE]; required_actions=[attach_po_amendment,vendor_bank_proof,procurement_reconcile_or_finance_2up].

matt: Two routes: wait for procurement to reconcile (theyre back tomorrow) OR Finance can do a temporary 2-person signoff to avoid late fee risk. Which do we want?

zoe: This is monthly infra usage billing (training infra). Vendor warned of 1% late after 5 days. Im leaning finance 2-up if vendor provides amendment + bank proof.

harper: Uploading amendment and bank ownership doc now. Link: https://files.polarvector.example/INV-0426-331-amend.pdf

kai: Amendment must include both PO numbers and vendor tax ID for procurement to reconcile later.

harper: Amendment includes TAX ID and references PV-4100-LEG -> PV-2026-420. Also added AP contact and bank proof.

matt: Zoe, please post GL and cost center so I can request treasury manual override. Need two approvers.

zoe: GL=5403-gpu-infra; cost_center=platform-training-prod. Audit note: "Temporary finance approval pending procurement reconciliation; docs attached."

approvals-bot: Documents attached. Pending actions updated: [treasury_manual_override,procurement_ticket].

matt: Submitted manual override to Treasury with ref "PolarVector merged entities; temporary finance 2-up; docs attached." ETA 24-36h. Flagged urgent due to late fee.

kai: Ill open procurement ticket now and set priority high. Will reconcile PO mapping when back.

harper: Vendor requests notification once payment is initiated. Theyre tight on cashflow.

zoe: Will monitor treasury and update thread. If Treasury rejects manual override, escalate to Finance Lead for emergency approval.

matt: Summary: amendment + bank proof attached; GL set; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold remains until procurement reconciles or treasury approves.

harper: Thanks everyone :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor merged payment entity caused PO mismatch and bank change; contains root message + replies in chronological order
